prose.intro: Choose a cooling system, a weather scenario, a cooling level and a controller. Every controller has an hour-by-hour July week and the numbers of the eight test weeks. The yearly chart exists only for the thermostat and the exact optimum, which were simulated for the whole year; the rule and the planners were simulated week by week.
prose.week_note: The week shown is the July test week, which holds the inserted heat wave in the heat-wave scenarios. The thermostat and optimum curves continue a year-long simulation; the rule and the planner start the week from empty tanks after a warm-up, so the first hours can differ a little between the two groups. Values are district sums of the six buildings.
prose.missing_note: This controller was not simulated hour by hour for this case.
